create.name: Ananda Sangha Chennai
create.bio:
Ananda Sangha Chennai is a meditation and yoga centre in the Kriya Yoga tradition of Paramhansa Yogananda, part of the worldwide Ananda movement started by his disciple Swami Kriyananda. It opened in June 2013, shortly after Kriyananda drew a crowd of some two thousand to a talk at the city's Music Academy and asked Nayaswamis Dharmarajan and Dharmini to settle in Chennai and lead a new centre; the couple remain its spiritual directors.

The centre is a house on East Road in CIT Nagar West, where classes are taught in person in English and Tamil. Beginners start with a one-day Learn to Meditate and Energize class, covering the Hong-Sau technique and Yogananda's Energization Exercises, which opens a graded course through raja yoga, discipleship and the Aum technique towards Kriya initiation.

Sundays begin with a fire ceremony and meditation, followed by a satsang of chanting, affirmations, prayer and a talk that is also streamed online. During the week there are group meditations and Wednesday "how-to-live" classes applying Yogananda's practical teachings to work, money, leadership and the cycles of history, along with yoga asana sessions and devotional music.

courses.title: Level 1: Learn to Meditate & Energize
courses.description: A one-day, in-person beginners' class (2:00–6:00 pm) on the Hong-Sau meditation technique and Yogananda's Energization Exercises, with handouts and a course textbook. Offered on 14, 15 and 19 November 2026 in English and Tamil; the first step towards Kriya initiation.

courses.title: Level 2: The Art and Science of Raja Yoga
courses.description: The second stage of the Kriya Yoga training course, based on Kriyananda's book of the same name: Patanjali's eight-fold path, karma and reincarnation, the chakras, the meaning of Aum and spirituality in daily life. Level 1 is a prerequisite; dates on the centre's calendar.

courses.title: "How-to-Live" classes
courses.description: Evening classes, usually on Wednesdays, on Yogananda's practical teachings for daily life as developed by Kriyananda: supportive leadership, money magnetism, how to be a success, the yugas and facing death.

free_resources.title: Sunday Satsang
free_resources.description: Every Sunday at the centre: a fire ceremony and meditation at 9 am, then a satsang at 10 am with chanting, singing, affirmations, meditation, prayers and an inspirational talk. In person and online; all welcome.
